findings.what: The Go back script goes back only if `ours && history.length > 1`. The spec's decision names the same-origin referrer as the only condition, and rejects `history.length > 1` as a check. The extra guard is a departure from the decision.
findings.fix: Drop `&& history.length > 1` so the condition is just the same-origin referrer.

findings.what: The Go back script is checked only by a regex on its text. No test runs the behaviour. The spec allows this, since AC-10 is verified by review.
findings.fix: None required. Optionally assert that the page is the only place the script appears.

findings.what: The states table says 'Go back' is hidden on the 200 rows. No test asserts that 'Go back' is absent on the 200 pages.
findings.fix: Add `expect(html).not.toContain('Go back')` to the list-page tests (AC-3, AC-5, AC-6).
